claim: Beliefs and contracts are two roles sharing one store: a belief says 'this is true'; a contract says 'this will remain true.'
invariants: Ordinary beliefs become stale and get superseded; contracts are behavioral invariants that get violated or upheld, not superseded

evidence.detail: Beliefs versus contracts: ordinary beliefs carry statuses active/superseded/retracted; contracts are contract-grade implications that may additionally use retired. Both live in the same store.
